title: Vault regeneration binary + delete-and-rebuild integration test (§6 test #5)
description:
Proves DESIGN.md §6 test #5: the vault can be deleted and fully regenerated from the Library.

Rust binary target (alcanzai-core/src/bin/alcanzai.rs or similar):
  Subcommands:
    alcanzai vault regenerate --library <path.db> --vault <path> — calls VaultProjection::rebuild.
    alcanzai vault render --library <path.db> --vault <path> — calls VaultProjection::render (incremental).

Integration test (cargo test -- --include-ignored or a separate test binary):
  1. Open SqliteLibrary with 2–3 hand-authored KnowledgeObjects (academic_pdf, web_article, one with abstract + enrichment).
  2. Call VaultProjection::rebuild → capture file list and content.
  3. Delete the vault directory entirely.
  4. Call VaultProjection::rebuild again.
  5. Assert: same file list, same file content (byte-for-byte or normalized).
  This is the §6 test #5 check and an agent can run it with cargo test.

Also test: regenerate a vault that already exists (render is idempotent on second call).

Acceptance criterion:
  - cargo run --bin alcanzai -- vault regenerate --help exits 0.
  - Integration test passes (delete + rebuild → diff empty).
  - cargo fmt + clippy clean.
